pick.headline: Suicide bombing destroys the US Embassy in Beirut
pick.fbis: The Middle East & Africa Daily Report of April 18, 1983, carried Beirut's Voice of Lebanon and Beirut Domestic Service: a car with a fake diplomatic plate crashed the U.S. Embassy entrance and exploded, with 20 employees and 5 marines reported killed.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 075, 18 April 1983

alternates.headline: US Navy strikes Iranian oil platforms and warships (Operation Praying Mantis)
alternates.fbis: The Near East & South Asia review of April 18, 1988, reported IRNA on U.S. fire against the Nasr and Salman platforms, Iran calling for a 'holy defense against the U.S. invasion', and Iranian counterattacks on a Gulf oil platform and British barge.

alternates.headline: Israeli shelling kills over 100 at the UN post at Qana
alternates.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of April 19, 1996, carried Cairo MENA: Foreign Minister Musa condemned Israel's strikes after the killing at Qana, where shelling of the Fijian UN contingent killed or wounded more than 150 sheltering civilians.
